lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Independent application: planning realistically around school

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic planning realistically around school task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: The learner lays out a full week (school, schoolwork time, rest, and other regular commitments already in their life) and fits their stated available working hours from earlier this year into the real remaining time, honestly, rather than assuming time that isn't actually there.
materials: learner-local: constraint notes from earlier this year

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l05-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l05-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l05-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l05-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: Was your original hours estimate from earlier this year realistic once you actually laid out the full week, or did it need to change?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g10-u06-l05-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Schedule realism: Working hours fit into genuinely open time, with at most a minor overlap. | Conflict-point identification: Names a real, specific conflict point from the actual schedule. | Honest reassessment of the original estimate: Honestly states whether the estimate held up, with a reason. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l05-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner build a second version of the schedule for a busier week (such as one with an extra regular commitment) and compare how much working time remains realistic.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic planning realistically around school task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.elapsedWindow: Up to seven days; use only the check-ins explicitly named in the task
duration.sessionPattern: 8–10 minutes model and planning, 8–10 minutes guided try, 20–30 minutes application, 7–10 minutes evidence and revision
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.label: constraint notes from earlier this year
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: planning realistically around school worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The learner lays out a full week (school, schoolwork time, rest, and other regular commitments already in their life) and fits their stated available working hours from earlier this year into the real remaining time, honestly, rather than assuming time that isn't actually there.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact planning realistically around school decision or action.
Model move 2: List your real weekly commitments: school, schoolwork time, rest, and anything else regular in your week.
Model move 3: Build a full weekly schedule and fit your stated available working hours into the real remaining time.

Model check: Schedule realism: Working hours fit into genuinely open time, with at most a minor overlap. | Conflict-point identification: Names a real, specific conflict point from the actual schedule. | Honest reassessment of the original estimate: Honestly states whether the estimate held up, with a reason.

resources.title: planning realistically around school action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal, constraints, and privacy boundary for planning realistically around school.
2. Analyze the worked model and identify why its sequence meets the criteria.
3. Complete the guided case and use feedback before moving on.
4. Select the permitted real-life route or the complete fictional route.
5. Carry out the task, retaining only the minimum evidence named in the record.
6. Compare the result with the success checks and complete the correction loop when needed.

resources.title: planning realistically around school coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner lays out a full week (school, schoolwork time, rest, and other regular commitments already in their life) and fits their stated available working hours from earlier this year into the real remaining time, honestly, rather than assuming time that isn't actually there.
Coach direction: List your real weekly commitments: school, schoolwork time, rest, and anything else regular in your week.
Learner prompt: List your real weekly commitments and roughly how many hours each takes.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: planning realistically around school complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Build a full weekly schedule and fit your stated available working hours into the real remaining time.
Response 1 (t2-p1): Lay out your weekly schedule with all commitments placed, then add your working hours into the genuinely open time.
Response 2 (t2-p2): My working hours fit into time that isn't already committed to something else.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: planning realistically around school minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Was your original hours estimate from earlier this year realistic once you actually laid out the full week, or did it need to change?

Success checks: Schedule realism: Working hours fit into genuinely open time, with at most a minor overlap. | Conflict-point identification: Names a real, specific conflict point from the actual schedule. | Honest reassessment of the original estimate: Honestly states whether the estimate held up, with a reason.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: planning realistically around school supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l05-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g10-u06-l05-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional planning realistically around school condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Schedule realism: Working hours fit into genuinely open time, with at most a minor overlap. | Conflict-point identification: Names a real, specific conflict point from the actual schedule. | Honest reassessment of the original estimate: Honestly states whether the estimate held up, with a reason..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l05-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
